translation.ne: अनियोजित तौल घट्नुका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild unplanned weight loss before bedtime, a safe first step is to use the medicine at the same time each day while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सुत्नुअघि हुने हल्का अनियोजित तौल घट्नुमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै हरेक दिन एउटै समयमा औषधि प्रयोग गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, burning chest after food plus black stool should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा खानापछि छाती पोल्नेसँगै कालो दिसा भए नियमित मधुमेह अनुगमनभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using insulin for lower back ache, a school-age child should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: तल्लो ढाड दुख्नेका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with diabetes can write whether sore throat is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after starting a new tablet.
translation.ne: भेटअघि मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले घाँटी खसखस लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild fever with chills while caring for a sick relative, a safe first step is to watch for changes over the next day while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा हुने हल्का कम्पनसहित ज्वरोमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै अर्को दिनसम्म परिवर्तनहरू हेर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During dental care, the clinician may ask whether fever with chills happens while caring for a sick relative, after each meal, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: दन्त हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले कम्पनसहित ज्वरो बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा, हरेक खाना पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild cough with phlegm during a fever episode, a safe first step is to rest until dizziness improves while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: ज्वरो आएको बेला हुने हल्का खकारसहित खोकीमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै चक्कर कम नभएसम्म आराम गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, cough with phlegm plus signs of severe dehydration should be placed ahead of routine pregnancy follow-up.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा खकारसहित खोकीसँगै कडा निर्जलीकरणका संकेत भए नियमित गर्भावस्था फलो-अपभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During child fever care, the clinician may ask whether excessive thirst happens during pregnancy, since yesterday, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: बच्चाको ज्वरो हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले धेरै तिर्खा गर्भावस्थामा, हिजोदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A breastfeeding mother reports excessive thirst during pregnancy since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमाले गर्भावस्थामा हिजोदेखि धेरै तिर्खा भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, pain around a wound plus black stool should be placed ahead of routine pregnancy follow-up.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा घाउ वरिपरि दुख्नेसँगै कालो दिसा भए नियमित गर्भावस्था फलो-अपभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During pregnancy follow-up, the clinician may ask whether pain around a wound happens after waking up, for the first time, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: गर्भावस्था फलो-अपको बेला चिकित्सकले घाउ वरिपरि दुख्ने ब्यूँझिएपछि, पहिलो पटक वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a school-age child book a check-up for fever with chills that occurs at work after one dose?
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले काममा एक मात्रा पछि हुने कम्पनसहित ज्वरोका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: During mental health support, the clinician may ask whether fever with chills happens at work, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहयोगको बेला चिकित्सकले कम्पनसहित ज्वरो काममा, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, an adult patient can write whether reduced hearing is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while breastfeeding.
translation.ne: भेटअघि वयस्क बिरामीले कम सुन्ने लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा स्तनपान गराउँदा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should an adult patient book a check-up for reduced hearing that occurs while breastfeeding after one dose?
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले स्तनपान गराउँदा एक मात्रा पछि हुने कम सुन्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: An adult patient reports watery eyes after a minor fall every evening, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले सानो लडाइपछि हरेक साँझ आँखाबाट पानी आउने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Watery eyes in an adult patient may need closer attention if it appears after a minor fall and is linked with major breathing trouble.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीमा सानो लडाइपछि देखिने आँखाबाट पानी आउने धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild fast heartbeat after waking up, a safe first step is to check temperature and fluid intake while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: ब्यूँझिएपछि हुने हल्का मुटु छिटो धड्किनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै तापक्रम र पिएको झोल पदार्थ जाँच्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During sleep counseling, the clinician may ask whether pelvic heaviness happens after a long bus ride, since yesterday, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: निद्रा परामर्शको बेला चिकित्सकले तल्लो पेट भारी हुनु लामो बस यात्रापछि, हिजोदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Pelvic heaviness in a breastfeeding mother may need closer attention if it appears after a long bus ride and is linked with high fever that does not settle.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमामा लामो बस यात्रापछि देखिने तल्लो पेट भारी हुनु नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: A breastfeeding mother reports pelvic heaviness after a long bus ride since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमाले लामो बस यात्रापछि हिजोदेखि तल्लो पेट भारी हुनु भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: A person taking daily medicine reports numb fingers during pregnancy every evening, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले गर्भावस्थामा हरेक साँझ औँला झमझमाउने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Numb fingers in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears during pregnancy and is linked with high fever that does not settle.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा गर्भावस्थामा देखिने औँला झमझमाउने नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a caregiver can write whether lightheadedness is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after dental cleaning.
translation.ne: भेटअघि हेरचाहकर्ताले हल्का चक्कर लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा दाँत सफा गराएपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person under stress can write whether numb fingers is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while breastfeeding.
translation.ne: भेटअघि तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिले औँला झमझमाउने लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा स्तनपान गराउँदा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During breathing problem care, the clinician may ask whether numb fingers happens while breastfeeding, every evening, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: श्वासप्रश्वास समस्या हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले औँला झमझमाउने स्तनपान गराउँदा, हरेक साँझ वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During urinary infection advice, the clinician may ask whether hard stool happens after starting a new tablet, after each meal, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहको बेला चिकित्सकले कडा दिसा नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि, हरेक खाना पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Hard stool in a person living alone may need closer attention if it appears after starting a new tablet and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि देखिने कडा दिसा धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild persistent worry after returning from travel, a safe first step is to limit frightening news and keep a routine while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हुने हल्का लगातार चिन्तामा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै डर लाग्ने समाचार कम हेरेर दिनचर्या कायम राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for persistent worry that occurs after returning from travel again this month?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने लगातार चिन्ताका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Should a teenager book a check-up for persistent worry that occurs during the night again this month?
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीले राति यो महिना फेरि हुने लगातार चिन्ताका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: During urinary infection advice, the clinician may ask whether persistent worry happens during the night, again this month, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहको बेला चिकित्सकले लगातार चिन्ता राति, यो महिना फेरि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Pelvic heaviness should be treated as urgent when a breastfeeding mother also has high fever that does not settle or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमामा तल्लो पेट भारी हुनुसँगै नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Sore throat should be treated as urgent when a teenager also has major breathing trouble or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीमा घाँटी खसखससँगै धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रो छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, sore throat plus major breathing trouble should be placed ahead of routine eye check-up.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा घाँटी खसखससँगै धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रो भए नियमित आँखा जाँचभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A person taking daily medicine reports loose stool while exercising for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले व्यायाम गर्दा दुई दिनदेखि पातलो दिसा भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether loose stool happens while exercising, for two days, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: रक्तचाप अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले पातलो दिसा व्यायाम गर्दा, दुई दिनदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild redness of the eye after dental cleaning, a safe first step is to avoid taking extra medicine without advice while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: दाँत सफा गराएपछि हुने हल्का आँखा रातो हुनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै सल्लाहबिना थप औषधि नखानु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with diabetes book a check-up for redness of the eye that occurs after dental cleaning again this month?
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले दाँत सफा गराएपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने आँखा रातो हुनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild mild fever after a minor fall, a safe first step is to limit frightening news and keep a routine while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सानो लडाइपछि हुने हल्का हल्का ज्वरोमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै डर लाग्ने समाचार कम हेरेर दिनचर्या कायम राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During breathing problem care, the clinician may ask whether mild fever happens after a minor fall, for several weeks, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: श्वासप्रश्वास समस्या हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले हल्का ज्वरो सानो लडाइपछि, धेरै हप्तादेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Ankle swelling should be treated as urgent when an adult patient also has seizure-like movements or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीमा गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निनेसँगै झट्का आउने जस्तो चाल छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should an adult patient book a check-up for ankle swelling that occurs after applying a new cream again this month?
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild itchy skin patches after a minor fall, a safe first step is to keep the affected area clean and dry while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सानो लडाइपछि हुने हल्का चिलाउने छालाका दागमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै प्रभावित ठाउँ सफा र सुख्खा राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During heart symptom review, the clinician may ask whether cough with phlegm happens during home isolation, during the last three nights, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मुटुका लक्षणको समीक्षाको बेला चिकित्सकले खकारसहित खोकी घरमै एकान्त बस्दा, पछिल्ला तीन रातमा वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a young child can write whether cough with phlegm is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during home isolation.
translation.ne: भेटअघि सानो बच्चाले खकारसहित खोकी लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Cough with phlegm in a young child may need closer attention if it appears during home isolation and is linked with high fever that does not settle.
translation.ne: सानो बच्चामा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा देखिने खकारसहित खोकी नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: If cough with phlegm is mild now, the safety plan should still mention high fever that does not settle, worsening pain, and poor fluid intake.
translation.ne: खकारसहित खोकी अहिले हल्का भए पनि सुरक्षा योजनामा नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो, दुखाइ बढ्नु र झोल पदार्थ कम लिनु उल्लेख गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, ankle swelling plus chest pain with sweating should be placed ahead of routine ear and throat review.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निनेसँगै पसिनासहित छाती दुख्नु भए नियमित कान र घाँटी समीक्षाभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During ear and throat review, the clinician may ask whether ankle swelling happens after climbing stairs, for several weeks, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: कान र घाँटी समीक्षाको बेला चिकित्सकले गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निने सिँढी चढेपछि, धेरै हप्तादेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild throbbing headache after dental cleaning, a safe first step is to use the medicine at the same time each day while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: दाँत सफा गराएपछि हुने हल्का धड्केजस्तो टाउको दुखाइमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै हरेक दिन एउटै समयमा औषधि प्रयोग गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for throbbing headache that occurs after dental cleaning for several weeks?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले दाँत सफा गराएपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने धड्केजस्तो टाउको दुखाइका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Cold-sensitive teeth should be treated as urgent when a person with diabetes also has sudden loss of vision or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिमा चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुनेसँगै अचानक दृष्टि हराउनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Cold-sensitive teeth in a person with diabetes may need closer attention if it appears after starting a new tablet and is linked with sudden loss of vision.
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिमा नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि देखिने चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुने अचानक दृष्टि हराउनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with diabetes book a check-up for cold-sensitive teeth that occurs after starting a new tablet for two days?
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि दुई दिनदेखि हुने चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A person with diabetes reports cold-sensitive teeth after starting a new tablet for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि दुई दिनदेखि चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Persistent worry should be treated as urgent when a caregiver also has reduced consciousness or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा लगातार चिन्तासँगै होस कम हुनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether persistent worry happens after a minor fall, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: रक्तचाप अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले लगातार चिन्ता सानो लडाइपछि, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for swollen knee that occurs while exercising every evening?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले व्यायाम गर्दा हरेक साँझ हुने घुँडा सुन्निनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before using allergy medicine for swollen knee, a patient after surgery should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: घुँडा सुन्निनेका लागि एलर्जीको औषधि प्रयोग गर्नुअघि शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Burning chest after food should be treated as urgent when an adult patient also has new confusion or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीमा खानापछि छाती पोल्नेसँगै नयाँ अलमल छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During urinary infection advice, the clinician may ask whether burning chest after food happens after returning from travel, for the first time, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहको बेला चिकित्सकले खानापछि छाती पोल्ने यात्राबाट फर्केपछि, पहिलो पटक वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, small skin blisters plus chest pain with sweating should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा छालामा साना फोकासँगै पसिनासहित छाती दुख्नु भए नियमित मधुमेह अनुगमनभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Small skin blisters in a pregnant patient may need closer attention if it appears during a fever episode and is linked with chest pain with sweating.
translation.ne: गर्भवती बिरामीमा ज्वरो आएको बेला देखिने छालामा साना फोका पसिनासहित छाती दुख्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a pregnant patient can write whether small skin blisters is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during a fever episode.
translation.ne: भेटअघि गर्भवती बिरामीले छालामा साना फोका लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा ज्वरो आएको बेला पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a pregnant patient book a check-up for small skin blisters that occurs during a fever episode after each meal?
translation.ne: गर्भवती बिरामीले ज्वरो आएको बेला हरेक खाना पछि हुने छालामा साना फोकाका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, itchy skin patches plus blood in vomit should be placed ahead of routine ear and throat review.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा चिलाउने छालाका दागसँगै बान्तामा रगत भए नियमित कान र घाँटी समीक्षाभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild itchy skin patches after starting a new tablet, a safe first step is to drink safe fluids in small amounts while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि हुने हल्का चिलाउने छालाका दागमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै सफा झोल पदार्थ थोरै थोरै पिउनु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, unplanned weight loss plus signs of severe dehydration should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा अनियोजित तौल घट्नुसँगै कडा निर्जलीकरणका संकेत भए नियमित मधुमेह अनुगमनभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should an adult patient book a check-up for unplanned weight loss that occurs after climbing stairs since yesterday?
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले सिँढी चढेपछि हिजोदेखि हुने अनियोजित तौल घट्नुका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Unplanned weight loss in a person with asthma may need closer attention if it appears after applying a new cream and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिमा नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि देखिने अनियोजित तौल घट्नु धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with asthma can write whether unplanned weight loss is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after applying a new cream.
translation.ne: भेटअघि दम भएको व्यक्तिले अनियोजित तौल घट्नु लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Numb fingers in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears during a fever episode and is linked with blue lips.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा ज्वरो आएको बेला देखिने औँला झमझमाउने ओठ निलो हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using insulin for numb fingers, a person taking daily medicine should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: औँला झमझमाउनेका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A teenager reports loose stool while exercising for the first time, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीले व्यायाम गर्दा पहिलो पटक पातलो दिसा भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, loose stool plus fainting should be placed ahead of routine mental health support.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा पातलो दिसासँगै बेहोस हुनु भए नियमित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहयोगभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During injury follow-up, the clinician may ask whether neck stiffness happens during home isolation, again this month, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: चोटपटक फलो-अपको बेला चिकित्सकले घाँटी कठ्यांग्रिने घरमै एकान्त बस्दा, यो महिना फेरि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Low mood in an older adult may need closer attention if it appears during home isolation and is linked with blue lips.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा देखिने मन उदास हुनु ओठ निलो हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Low mood should be treated as urgent when an older adult also has blue lips or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा मन उदास हुनुसँगै ओठ निलो हुनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild ear discharge after climbing stairs, a safe first step is to rest until dizziness improves while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सिँढी चढेपछि हुने हल्का कानबाट तरल बग्नेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै चक्कर कम नभएसम्म आराम गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Before using pain medicine for ear discharge, a person with diabetes should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: कानबाट तरल बग्नेका लागि दुखाइको औषधि प्रयोग गर्नुअघि मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with diabetes book a check-up for ear discharge that occurs after climbing stairs since yesterday?
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले सिँढी चढेपछि हिजोदेखि हुने कानबाट तरल बग्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A follow-up visit is useful when ear discharge improves briefly but returns during home isolation or interferes with daily activities.
translation.ne: कानबाट तरल बग्ने छोटो समय कम भएर घरमै एकान्त बस्दा फेरि फर्किन्छ वा दैनिक काममा असर गर्छ भने फलो-अप भेट उपयोगी हुन्छ।

translation.en: Ear discharge in a person with asthma may need closer attention if it appears during home isolation and is linked with blood in vomit.
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिमा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा देखिने कानबाट तरल बग्ने बान्तामा रगतसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: A school-age child reports white vaginal discharge while resting for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले आराम गर्दा दुई दिनदेखि योनीबाट सेतो पानी आउने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild watery eyes after eating oily food, a safe first step is to rest until dizziness improves while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि हुने हल्का आँखाबाट पानी आउनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै चक्कर कम नभएसम्म आराम गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Watery eyes in a person with asthma may need closer attention if it appears after eating oily food and is linked with blue lips.
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिमा तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि देखिने आँखाबाट पानी आउने ओठ निलो हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Unplanned weight loss in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears after waking up and is linked with swelling of lips or face.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा ब्यूँझिएपछि देखिने अनियोजित तौल घट्नु ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, unplanned weight loss plus swelling of lips or face should be placed ahead of routine mental health support.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा अनियोजित तौल घट्नुसँगै ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनु भए नियमित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहयोगभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Unplanned weight loss should be treated as urgent when a person taking daily medicine also has swelling of lips or face or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा अनियोजित तौल घट्नुसँगै ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Low mood should be treated as urgent when a school-age child also has blood in vomit or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चामा मन उदास हुनुसँगै बान्तामा रगत छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During post-delivery care, the clinician may ask whether low mood happens during a fever episode, on and off, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: प्रसवपछिको हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले मन उदास हुनु ज्वरो आएको बेला, कहिले काहीँ वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with asthma book a check-up for ear discharge that occurs after eating oily food after each meal?
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिले तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि हरेक खाना पछि हुने कानबाट तरल बग्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild sore throat after starting a new tablet, a safe first step is to keep the affected area clean and dry while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि हुने हल्का घाँटी खसखसमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै प्रभावित ठाउँ सफा र सुख्खा राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Bad breath in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears after eating oily food and is linked with weakness on one side of the body.

translation.en: If a person living alone cannot clearly describe cough with phlegm, a caregiver can note the timing, triggers, and associated changes.

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether fever with chills happens after waking up, for two days, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: A young child reports fever with chills after waking up for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Fever with chills in a young child may need closer attention if it appears after waking up and is linked with sudden loss of vision.
translation.ne: सानो बच्चामा ब्यूँझिएपछि देखिने कम्पनसहित ज्वरो अचानक दृष्टि हराउनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild cold-sensitive teeth after dental cleaning, a safe first step is to avoid sharing prescribed medicine while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: दाँत सफा गराएपछि हुने हल्का चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै निर्धारित औषधि अरूसँग नबाँड्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Cold-sensitive teeth should be treated as urgent when a breastfeeding mother also has blue lips or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमामा चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुनेसँगै ओठ निलो हुनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Burning urination should be treated as urgent when an older adult also has fainting or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा पिसाब गर्दा पोल्नेसँगै बेहोस हुनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, burning urination plus fainting should be placed ahead of routine heart symptom review.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा पिसाब गर्दा पोल्नेसँगै बेहोस हुनु भए नियमित मुटुका लक्षणको समीक्षाभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During injury follow-up, the clinician may ask whether mild fever happens during home isolation, during the last three nights, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: Watery eyes in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears after waking up and is linked with blue lips.

translation.en: A caregiver reports abdominal cramps after dental cleaning after one dose, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले दाँत सफा गराएपछि एक मात्रा पछि पेट मरोडिने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a caregiver book a check-up for abdominal cramps that occurs after dental cleaning after one dose?

translation.en: For mild fast heartbeat at work, a safe first step is to record the start time and pattern while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: काममा हुने हल्का मुटु छिटो धड्किनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै सुरु भएको समय र ढाँचा लेखेर राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a teenager book a check-up for redness of the eye that occurs after climbing stairs for two days?
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीले सिँढी चढेपछि दुई दिनदेखि हुने आँखा रातो हुनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with diabetes can write whether frequent urination is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while breastfeeding.

translation.en: Numb fingers should be treated as urgent when a person taking daily medicine also has new confusion or the symptom rapidly worsens.

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, lower back ache plus high fever that does not settle should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.

translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिमा लामो बस यात्रापछि देखिने बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्ने होस कम हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with asthma book a check-up for frequent urination that occurs after a long bus ride on and off?
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिले लामो बस यात्रापछि कहिले काहीँ हुने बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Sudden panic in a school-age child may need closer attention if it appears during a fever episode and is linked with seizure-like movements.
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चामा ज्वरो आएको बेला देखिने अचानक आत्तिने झट्का आउने जस्तो चालसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with high blood pressure book a check-up for bleeding gums that occurs at work every evening?
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले काममा हरेक साँझ हुने गिजाबाट रगत आउनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, reduced hearing plus black stool should be placed ahead of routine urinary infection advice.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा कम सुन्नेसँगै कालो दिसा भए नियमित पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person under stress book a check-up for reduced hearing that occurs during the night for several weeks?
translation.ne: तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिले राति धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने कम सुन्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: During digestive complaint care, the clinician may ask whether sudden panic happens before bedtime, for several weeks, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: पाचन सम्बन्धी गुनासो हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले अचानक आत्तिने सुत्नुअघि, धेरै हप्तादेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Sudden panic in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears before bedtime and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिमा सुत्नुअघि देखिने अचानक आत्तिने धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a caregiver book a check-up for chest discomfort that occurs after dental cleaning for the first time?
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले दाँत सफा गराएपछि पहिलो पटक हुने छातीमा असहजताका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild chest discomfort after dental cleaning, a safe first step is to limit frightening news and keep a routine while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: दाँत सफा गराएपछि हुने हल्का छातीमा असहजतामा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै डर लाग्ने समाचार कम हेरेर दिनचर्या कायम राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should an older adult book a check-up for mild fever that occurs after climbing stairs during the last three nights?
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिले सिँढी चढेपछि पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हुने हल्का ज्वरोका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before using skin ointment for mild fever, an older adult should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: हल्का ज्वरोका लागि छालाको मलम प्रयोग गर्नुअघि वृद्ध व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Mild fever in an older adult may need closer attention if it appears after climbing stairs and is linked with blue lips.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा सिँढी चढेपछि देखिने हल्का ज्वरो ओठ निलो हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During pregnancy follow-up, the clinician may ask whether breathlessness happens after eating oily food, for the first time, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: गर्भावस्था फलो-अपको बेला चिकित्सकले सास फुल्ने तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि, पहिलो पटक वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild reduced appetite after applying a new cream, a safe first step is to record the start time and pattern while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि हुने हल्का भोक कम हुनुमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै सुरु भएको समय र ढाँचा लेखेर राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Sore throat should be treated as urgent when a patient after surgery also has new confusion or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा घाँटी खसखससँगै नयाँ अलमल छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a caregiver can write whether hard stool is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after a minor fall.
translation.ne: भेटअघि हेरचाहकर्ताले कडा दिसा लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा सानो लडाइपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A caregiver reports hard stool after a minor fall for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले सानो लडाइपछि दुई दिनदेखि कडा दिसा भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild hard stool after a minor fall, a safe first step is to check temperature and fluid intake while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सानो लडाइपछि हुने हल्का कडा दिसामा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै तापक्रम र पिएको झोल पदार्थ जाँच्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During urinary infection advice, the clinician may ask whether shoulder stiffness happens after eating oily food, since yesterday, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहको बेला चिकित्सकले काँध कठ्यांग्रिने तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि, हिजोदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A person with diabetes reports fast heartbeat after climbing stairs since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले सिँढी चढेपछि हिजोदेखि मुटु छिटो धड्किने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, shoulder stiffness plus black stool should be placed ahead of routine nutrition advice.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा काँध कठ्यांग्रिनेसँगै कालो दिसा भए नियमित पोषण सल्लाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild shoulder stiffness after returning from travel, a safe first step is to wash hands before touching the wound while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हुने हल्का काँध कठ्यांग्रिनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै घाउ छुनुअघि हात धुनु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: A young child reports shoulder stiffness after returning from travel since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: सानो बच्चाले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हिजोदेखि काँध कठ्यांग्रिने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Neck stiffness in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears during the night and is linked with new confusion.
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिमा राति देखिने घाँटी कठ्यांग्रिने नयाँ अलमलसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with high blood pressure can write whether neck stiffness is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during the night.
translation.ne: भेटअघि उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले घाँटी कठ्यांग्रिने लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा राति पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Small skin blisters should be treated as urgent when a person taking daily medicine also has major breathing trouble or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा छालामा साना फोकासँगै धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रो छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild small skin blisters after returning from travel, a safe first step is to avoid sharing prescribed medicine while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हुने हल्का छालामा साना फोकामा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै निर्धारित औषधि अरूसँग नबाँड्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: During child fever care, the clinician may ask whether numb fingers happens after climbing stairs, for two days, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: बच्चाको ज्वरो हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले औँला झमझमाउने सिँढी चढेपछि, दुई दिनदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During diabetes monitoring, the clinician may ask whether cough with phlegm happens during the night, again this month, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मधुमेह अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले खकारसहित खोकी राति, यो महिना फेरि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before using insulin for cough with phlegm, a teenager should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: खकारसहित खोकीका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि किशोरकिशोरीले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, abdominal cramps plus fainting should be placed ahead of routine pregnancy follow-up.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा पेट मरोडिनेसँगै बेहोस हुनु भए नियमित गर्भावस्था फलो-अपभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, cough with phlegm plus blue lips should be placed ahead of routine skin care.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा खकारसहित खोकीसँगै ओठ निलो हुनु भए नियमित छाला हेरचाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During diabetes monitoring, the clinician may ask whether sore throat happens after skipping breakfast, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मधुमेह अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले घाँटी खसखस बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with asthma can write whether sore throat is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after skipping breakfast.
translation.ne: भेटअघि दम भएको व्यक्तिले घाँटी खसखस लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, unplanned weight loss plus blood in vomit should be placed ahead of routine nutrition advice.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा अनियोजित तौल घट्नुसँगै बान्तामा रगत भए नियमित पोषण सल्लाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild unplanned weight loss after climbing stairs, a safe first step is to keep the affected area clean and dry while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सिँढी चढेपछि हुने हल्का अनियोजित तौल घट्नुमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै प्रभावित ठाउँ सफा र सुख्खा राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, reduced baby movement plus blood in vomit should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा बच्चाको चाल कम हुनुसँगै बान्तामा रगत भए नियमित मधुमेह अनुगमनभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: An adult patient reports reduced baby movement after eating oily food after each meal, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि हरेक खाना पछि बच्चाको चाल कम हुनु भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, pelvic heaviness plus sudden loss of vision should be placed ahead of routine urinary infection advice.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा तल्लो पेट भारी हुनुसँगै अचानक दृष्टि हराउनु भए नियमित पिसाब संक्रमण सल्लाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild pelvic heaviness during home isolation, a safe first step is to rest until dizziness improves while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: घरमै एकान्त बस्दा हुने हल्का तल्लो पेट भारी हुनुमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै चक्कर कम नभएसम्म आराम गर्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Pelvic heaviness should be treated as urgent when an older adult also has sudden loss of vision or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा तल्लो पेट भारी हुनुसँगै अचानक दृष्टि हराउनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using insulin for pain around a wound, an older adult should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: घाउ वरिपरि दुख्नेका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि वृद्ध व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should an older adult book a check-up for pain around a wound that occurs while exercising after each meal?
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिले व्यायाम गर्दा हरेक खाना पछि हुने घाउ वरिपरि दुख्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before the appointment, an older adult can write whether hard stool is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during the night.
translation.ne: भेटअघि वृद्ध व्यक्तिले कडा दिसा लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा राति पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before using insulin for hard stool, an older adult should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: कडा दिसाका लागि इन्सुलिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि वृद्ध व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, low mood plus high fever that does not settle should be placed ahead of routine blood pressure monitoring.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा मन उदास हुनुसँगै नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो भए नियमित रक्तचाप अनुगमनभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a caregiver can write whether low mood is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during home isolation.
translation.ne: भेटअघि हेरचाहकर्ताले मन उदास हुनु लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A caregiver reports low mood during home isolation during the last three nights, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले घरमै एकान्त बस्दा पछिल्ला तीन रातमा मन उदास हुनु भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Lower back ache should be treated as urgent when an older adult also has swelling of lips or face or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिमा तल्लो ढाड दुख्नेसँगै ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild lower back ache after starting a new tablet, a safe first step is to note whether food changes the symptom while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: नयाँ चक्की सुरु गरेपछि हुने हल्का तल्लो ढाड दुख्नेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै खानाले लक्षण बदलिन्छ कि छैन लेख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, watery eyes plus fainting should be placed ahead of routine diabetes monitoring.

translation.en: Excessive thirst in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears after eating oily food and is linked with fainting.

translation.en: For mild excessive thirst after eating oily food, a safe first step is to measure blood pressure if possible while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: A person under stress reports itchy skin patches while resting again this month, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Before using blood pressure medicine for itchy skin patches, a person under stress should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.

translation.en: A patient after surgery reports cough with phlegm before bedtime for the first time, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले सुत्नुअघि पहिलो पटक खकारसहित खोकी भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, cough with phlegm plus reduced consciousness should be placed ahead of routine nutrition advice.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा खकारसहित खोकीसँगै होस कम हुनु भए नियमित पोषण सल्लाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild burning chest after food after climbing stairs, a safe first step is to stay away from smoke and dust while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: सिँढी चढेपछि हुने हल्का खानापछि छाती पोल्नेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै धुवाँ र धुलोबाट टाढा बस्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: A school-age child reports bleeding gums during pregnancy for several weeks, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले गर्भावस्थामा धेरै हप्तादेखि गिजाबाट रगत आउने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During injury follow-up, the clinician may ask whether bleeding gums happens during pregnancy, for several weeks, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: चोटपटक फलो-अपको बेला चिकित्सकले गिजाबाट रगत आउने गर्भावस्थामा, धेरै हप्तादेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Watery eyes should be treated as urgent when a patient after surgery also has reduced consciousness or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा आँखाबाट पानी आउनेसँगै होस कम हुनु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for watery eyes that occurs after waking up again this month?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले ब्यूँझिएपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने आँखाबाट पानी आउनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A young child reports lightheadedness during a fever episode during the last three nights, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: सानो बच्चाले ज्वरो आएको बेला पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हल्का चक्कर भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with diabetes book a check-up for morning nausea that occurs after eating oily food for several weeks?
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने बिहान वाकवाकीका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before using eye drops for low mood, a person with high blood pressure should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: मन उदास हुनुका लागि आँखाको थोपा प्रयोग गर्नुअघि उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During pregnancy follow-up, the clinician may ask whether low mood happens while resting, after one dose, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: For mild morning nausea while exercising, a safe first step is to tell the clinician about all current medicines while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: व्यायाम गर्दा हुने हल्का बिहान वाकवाकीमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै हाल खाइरहेका सबै औषधिबारे चिकित्सकलाई बताउनु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild reduced hearing while exercising, a safe first step is to bring previous reports to the visit while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: व्यायाम गर्दा हुने हल्का कम सुन्नेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै भेटमा पहिलेका रिपोर्ट ल्याउनु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Reduced hearing in a person living alone may need closer attention if it appears while exercising and is linked with weakness on one side of the body.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा व्यायाम गर्दा देखिने कम सुन्ने शरीरको एकातिर कमजोरीसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Reduced hearing should be treated as urgent when a person living alone also has weakness on one side of the body or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा कम सुन्नेसँगै शरीरको एकातिर कमजोरी छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Sore throat in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears after applying a new cream and is linked with swelling of lips or face.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि देखिने घाँटी खसखस ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Hard stool in a teenager may need closer attention if it appears at work and is linked with seizure-like movements.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीमा काममा देखिने कडा दिसा झट्का आउने जस्तो चालसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using fever medicine for ear discharge, a person taking daily medicine should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.

translation.en: For mild watery eyes after applying a new cream, a safe first step is to tell the clinician about all current medicines while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि हुने हल्का आँखाबाट पानी आउनेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै हाल खाइरहेका सबै औषधिबारे चिकित्सकलाई बताउनु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a person under stress book a check-up for lightheadedness that occurs while breastfeeding during the last three nights?
translation.ne: तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिले स्तनपान गराउँदा पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हुने हल्का चक्करका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A person under stress reports lightheadedness while breastfeeding during the last three nights, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिले स्तनपान गराउँदा पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हल्का चक्कर भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: In pregnancy follow-up, education should include how to tell the clinician about all current medicines and when to contact a health facility.

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether shoulder stiffness happens after eating oily food, since yesterday, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, shoulder stiffness plus major breathing trouble should be placed ahead of routine blood pressure monitoring.

translation.en: Shoulder stiffness in a person with high blood pressure may need closer attention if it appears while caring for a sick relative and is linked with swelling of lips or face.

translation.en: A person living alone reports shoulder stiffness after waking up since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: If a school-age child cannot clearly describe burning chest after food, a caregiver can note the timing, triggers, and associated changes.
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले खानापछि छाती पोल्ने स्पष्ट बताउन नसके हेरचाहकर्ताले समय, कारण र साथमा देखिएका परिवर्तनहरू लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether burning chest after food happens while exercising, during the last three nights, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person taking daily medicine can write whether throbbing headache is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while exercising.

translation.en: A person taking daily medicine reports throbbing headache while exercising after one dose, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: During post-delivery care, the clinician may ask whether fast heartbeat happens after dental cleaning, for two days, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: During blood pressure monitoring, the clinician may ask whether swollen knee happens during the night, after one dose, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person taking daily medicine can write whether swollen knee is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during the night.

translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने सुख्खा चिरिएको छालाका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Should a breastfeeding mother book a check-up for throbbing headache that occurs after a minor fall for two days?
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमाले सानो लडाइपछि दुई दिनदेखि हुने धड्केजस्तो टाउको दुखाइका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before the appointment, a teenager can write whether burning urination is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while caring for a sick relative.
translation.ne: भेटअघि किशोरकिशोरीले पिसाब गर्दा पोल्ने लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A person with asthma reports pain around a wound while caring for a sick relative after one dose, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: दम भएको व्यक्तिले बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा एक मात्रा पछि घाउ वरिपरि दुख्ने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During diabetes monitoring, the clinician may ask whether pain around a wound happens while caring for a sick relative, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मधुमेह अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले घाउ वरिपरि दुख्ने बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During skin care, the clinician may ask whether frequent urination happens after skipping breakfast, for the first time, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: छाला हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्ने बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि, पहिलो पटक वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, an older adult can write whether frequent urination is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after skipping breakfast.
translation.ne: भेटअघि वृद्ध व्यक्तिले बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्ने लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, frequent urination plus blue lips should be placed ahead of routine skin care.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्नेसँगै ओठ निलो हुनु भए नियमित छाला हेरचाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Swollen knee in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears while exercising and is linked with high fever that does not settle.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिमा व्यायाम गर्दा देखिने घुँडा सुन्निने नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person taking daily medicine book a check-up for swollen knee that occurs while exercising every evening?
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले व्यायाम गर्दा हरेक साँझ हुने घुँडा सुन्निनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Neck stiffness in a person under stress may need closer attention if it appears during home isolation and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिमा घरमै एकान्त बस्दा देखिने घाँटी कठ्यांग्रिने धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using oral rehydration solution for neck stiffness, a person under stress should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: घाँटी कठ्यांग्रिनेका लागि ओआरएस झोल प्रयोग गर्नुअघि तनावमा रहेको व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a breastfeeding mother book a check-up for burning urination that occurs while caring for a sick relative after each meal?
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउने आमाले बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा हरेक खाना पछि हुने पिसाब गर्दा पोल्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild burning urination while caring for a sick relative, a safe first step is to call the clinic before changing treatment while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a school-age child can write whether sore throat is constant, comes in episodes, or follows during the night.

translation.en: For mild sore throat during the night, a safe first step is to note whether food changes the symptom while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: राति हुने हल्का घाँटी खसखसमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै खानाले लक्षण बदलिन्छ कि छैन लेख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Excessive thirst in a person living alone may need closer attention if it appears while exercising and is linked with chest pain with sweating.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा व्यायाम गर्दा देखिने धेरै तिर्खा पसिनासहित छाती दुख्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During urinary infection advice, the clinician may ask whether mild fever happens while exercising, for several weeks, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for excessive thirst that occurs while resting for several weeks?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले आराम गर्दा धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने धेरै तिर्खाका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A patient after surgery reports excessive thirst while resting for several weeks, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले आराम गर्दा धेरै हप्तादेखि धेरै तिर्खा भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During diabetes monitoring, the clinician may ask whether reduced baby movement happens during the night, after one dose, or after taking medicine.

translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले राति एक मात्रा पछि हुने बच्चाको चाल कम हुनुका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Reduced baby movement should be treated as urgent when a caregiver also has new confusion or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा बच्चाको चाल कम हुनुसँगै नयाँ अलमल छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: If reduced baby movement is mild now, the safety plan should still mention new confusion, worsening pain, and poor fluid intake.
translation.ne: बच्चाको चाल कम हुनु अहिले हल्का भए पनि सुरक्षा योजनामा नयाँ अलमल, दुखाइ बढ्नु र झोल पदार्थ कम लिनु उल्लेख गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Reduced baby movement should be treated as urgent when a caregiver also has high fever that does not settle or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा बच्चाको चाल कम हुनुसँगै नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A caregiver reports reduced baby movement after eating oily food for several weeks, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि बच्चाको चाल कम हुनु भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Unplanned weight loss in a person living alone may need closer attention if it appears while exercising and is linked with major breathing trouble.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा व्यायाम गर्दा देखिने अनियोजित तौल घट्नु धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a school-age child can write whether bad breath is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after dental cleaning.

translation.en: Should a school-age child book a check-up for bad breath that occurs after dental cleaning after one dose?
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले दाँत सफा गराएपछि एक मात्रा पछि हुने मुख गन्हाउनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A person with high blood pressure reports lower back ache while caring for a sick relative after each meal, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले बिरामी आफन्तको हेरचाह गर्दा हरेक खाना पछि तल्लो ढाड दुख्ने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: For mild lower back ache while caring for a sick relative, a safe first step is to drink safe fluids in small amounts while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: Itchy skin patches in a person living alone may need closer attention if it appears after returning from travel and is linked with seizure-like movements.
translation.ne: एक्लै बस्ने व्यक्तिमा यात्राबाट फर्केपछि देखिने चिलाउने छालाका दाग झट्का आउने जस्तो चालसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Fast heartbeat in a school-age child may need closer attention if it appears after climbing stairs and is linked with seizure-like movements.

translation.en: Should a school-age child book a check-up for fast heartbeat that occurs after climbing stairs for several weeks?
translation.ne: विद्यालय जाने उमेरको बच्चाले सिँढी चढेपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने मुटु छिटो धड्किनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Chest discomfort should be treated as urgent when a person with diabetes also has blood in vomit or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिमा छातीमा असहजतासँगै बान्तामा रगत छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with diabetes can write whether chest discomfort is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after a minor fall.
translation.ne: भेटअघि मधुमेह भएको व्यक्तिले छातीमा असहजता लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा सानो लडाइपछि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During sleep counseling, the clinician may ask whether ankle swelling happens during the night, after each meal, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: निद्रा परामर्शको बेला चिकित्सकले गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निने राति, हरेक खाना पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a breastfeeding mother can write whether low mood is constant, comes in episodes, or follows while exercising.
translation.ne: भेटअघि स्तनपान गराउने आमाले मन उदास हुनु लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा व्यायाम गर्दा पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: During breathing problem care, the clinician may ask whether low mood happens while exercising, again this month, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: श्वासप्रश्वास समस्या हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले मन उदास हुनु व्यायाम गर्दा, यो महिना फेरि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Loose stool should be treated as urgent when a patient after surgery also has heavy bleeding or the symptom rapidly worsens.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा पातलो दिसासँगै धेरै रगत बग्नु छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: An adult patient reports cough with phlegm during the night after each meal, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person with high blood pressure can write whether lightheadedness is constant, comes in episodes, or follows before bedtime.

translation.en: Dry cracked skin in a breastfeeding mother may need closer attention if it appears after climbing stairs and is linked with weakness on one side of the body.

translation.en: An older adult reports chest discomfort before bedtime during the last three nights, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Reduced appetite in a school-age child may need closer attention if it appears after a minor fall and is linked with heavy bleeding.

translation.en: A teenager reports redness of the eye after a minor fall for the first time, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीले सानो लडाइपछि पहिलो पटक आँखा रातो हुने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, redness of the eye plus major breathing trouble should be placed ahead of routine urinary infection advice.

translation.en: For mild bleeding gums after applying a new cream, a safe first step is to rest until dizziness improves while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, bleeding gums plus fainting should be placed ahead of routine child fever care.

translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा गोडाको गोलीगाँठो सुन्निनेसँगै धेरै रगत बग्नु भए नियमित दन्त हेरचाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A teenager reports redness of the eye after a long bus ride since yesterday, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Redness of the eye in a teenager may need closer attention if it appears after a long bus ride and is linked with swelling of lips or face.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीमा लामो बस यात्रापछि देखिने आँखा रातो हुने ओठ वा अनुहार सुन्निनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Sudden panic in a caregiver may need closer attention if it appears during the night and is linked with reduced consciousness.

translation.en: During nutrition advice, the clinician may ask whether pelvic heaviness happens at work, after one dose, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: For mild small skin blisters after skipping breakfast, a safe first step is to use the medicine at the same time each day while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, small skin blisters plus high fever that does not settle should be placed ahead of routine post-delivery care.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा छालामा साना फोकासँगै नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो भए नियमित प्रसवपछिको हेरचाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A patient after surgery reports small skin blisters after skipping breakfast after one dose, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि एक मात्रा पछि छालामा साना फोका भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Small skin blisters in a patient after surgery may need closer attention if it appears after skipping breakfast and is linked with high fever that does not settle.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि देखिने छालामा साना फोका नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरोसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a patient after surgery book a check-up for pelvic heaviness that occurs after applying a new cream since yesterday?
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीले नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि हिजोदेखि हुने तल्लो पेट भारी हुनुका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Pelvic heaviness in a patient after surgery may need closer attention if it appears after applying a new cream and is linked with signs of severe dehydration.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा नयाँ क्रिम लगाएपछि देखिने तल्लो पेट भारी हुनु कडा निर्जलीकरणका संकेतसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should an older adult book a check-up for breathlessness that occurs after returning from travel since yesterday?
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हिजोदेखि हुने सास फुल्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Before using ear drops for numb fingers, a young child should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: औँला झमझमाउनेका लागि कानको थोपा प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सानो बच्चाले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: An older adult reports lightheadedness during the night during the last three nights, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिले राति पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हल्का चक्कर भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should an older adult book a check-up for lightheadedness that occurs during the night during the last three nights?
translation.ne: वृद्ध व्यक्तिले राति पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हुने हल्का चक्करका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: During pregnancy follow-up, the clinician may ask whether chest discomfort happens after a minor fall, for two days, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: Chest discomfort in a caregiver may need closer attention if it appears after a minor fall and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा सानो लडाइपछि देखिने छातीमा असहजता धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, reduced hearing plus high fever that does not settle should be placed ahead of routine breathing problem care.
translation.ne: क्लिनिकका केस छुट्याउँदा कम सुन्नेसँगै नघट्ने उच्च ज्वरो भए नियमित श्वासप्रश्वास समस्या हेरचाहभन्दा अगाडि राख्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During breathing problem care, the clinician may ask whether reduced hearing happens after eating oily food, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: श्वासप्रश्वास समस्या हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले कम सुन्ने तेलिलो खाना खाएपछि, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: Should an adult patient book a check-up for morning nausea that occurs after returning from travel again this month?
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने बिहान वाकवाकीका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Morning nausea in an adult patient may need closer attention if it appears after returning from travel and is linked with seizure-like movements.
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीमा यात्राबाट फर्केपछि देखिने बिहान वाकवाकी झट्का आउने जस्तो चालसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Reduced appetite in a patient after surgery may need closer attention if it appears during a fever episode and is linked with new confusion.
translation.ne: शल्यक्रियापछि भएको बिरामीमा ज्वरो आएको बेला देखिने भोक कम हुनु नयाँ अलमलसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During diabetes monitoring, the clinician may ask whether reduced appetite happens during a fever episode, after one dose, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: मधुमेह अनुगमनको बेला चिकित्सकले भोक कम हुनु ज्वरो आएको बेला, एक मात्रा पछि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: A patient after surgery reports reduced appetite during a fever episode after one dose, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.

translation.en: Before using diabetes tablets for frequent urination, a person taking daily medicine should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.

translation.en: Frequent urination in a person taking daily medicine may need closer attention if it appears while caring for a sick relative and is linked with blood in vomit.

translation.en: A person taking daily medicine reports unusual tiredness after returning from travel for several weeks, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि असामान्य थकान भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person taking daily medicine book a check-up for unusual tiredness that occurs after returning from travel for several weeks?
translation.ne: दैनिक औषधि खाने व्यक्तिले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि हुने असामान्य थकानका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: For mild low mood during home isolation, a safe first step is to drink safe fluids in small amounts while watching for new warning signs.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a person living alone can write whether mouth ulcer is constant, comes in episodes, or follows at work.

translation.en: Before the appointment, a pregnant patient can write whether pelvic heaviness is constant, comes in episodes, or follows before bedtime.
translation.ne: भेटअघि गर्भवती बिरामीले तल्लो पेट भारी हुनु लगातार हो, एपिसोडमा आउँछ वा सुत्नुअघि पछि हुन्छ भनेर लेख्न सक्छ।

translation.en: If a caregiver cannot clearly describe low mood, a caregiver can note the timing, triggers, and associated changes.

translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा मन उदास हुनुसँगै धेरै सास फेर्न गाह्रो छ वा लक्षण छिटो बढ्छ भने यसलाई आकस्मिक मान्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: During post-delivery care, the clinician may ask whether ear discharge happens while breastfeeding, since yesterday, or after taking medicine.

translation.en: For mild reduced hearing while breastfeeding, a safe first step is to keep the affected area clean and dry while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: स्तनपान गराउँदा हुने हल्का कम सुन्नेमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै प्रभावित ठाउँ सफा र सुख्खा राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a person under stress book a check-up for dry cracked skin that occurs after skipping breakfast since yesterday?

translation.en: Cough with phlegm in a caregiver may need closer attention if it appears after skipping breakfast and is linked with heavy bleeding.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्तामा बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि देखिने खकारसहित खोकी धेरै रगत बग्नुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Watery eyes in a young child may need closer attention if it appears after returning from travel and is linked with seizure-like movements.
translation.ne: सानो बच्चामा यात्राबाट फर्केपछि देखिने आँखाबाट पानी आउने झट्का आउने जस्तो चालसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a person with high blood pressure book a check-up for mild fever that occurs after climbing stairs every evening?
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले सिँढी चढेपछि हरेक साँझ हुने हल्का ज्वरोका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Cold-sensitive teeth in a pregnant patient may need closer attention if it appears while breastfeeding and is linked with blue lips.
translation.ne: गर्भवती बिरामीमा स्तनपान गराउँदा देखिने चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुने ओठ निलो हुनुसँग सम्बन्धित छ भने बढी ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Should a pregnant patient book a check-up for cold-sensitive teeth that occurs while breastfeeding for two days?
translation.ne: गर्भवती बिरामीले स्तनपान गराउँदा दुई दिनदेखि हुने चिसोमा दाँत सिरिङ्ग हुनेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: Should an adult patient book a check-up for frequent urination that occurs during the night during the last three nights?
translation.ne: वयस्क बिरामीले राति पछिल्ला तीन रातमा हुने बारम्बार पिसाब लाग्नेका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A caregiver reports itchy skin patches after returning from travel for two days, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: हेरचाहकर्ताले यात्राबाट फर्केपछि दुई दिनदेखि चिलाउने छालाका दाग भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: During child fever care, the clinician may ask whether itchy skin patches happens after returning from travel, for two days, or after taking medicine.
translation.ne: बच्चाको ज्वरो हेरचाहको बेला चिकित्सकले चिलाउने छालाका दाग यात्राबाट फर्केपछि, दुई दिनदेखि वा औषधि खाएपछि हुन्छ कि भनेर सोध्न सक्छ।

translation.en: For mild itchy skin patches after returning from travel, a safe first step is to record the start time and pattern while watching for new warning signs.
translation.ne: यात्राबाट फर्केपछि हुने हल्का चिलाउने छालाका दागमा नयाँ चेतावनी संकेत हेर्दै सुरु भएको समय र ढाँचा लेखेर राख्नु सुरक्षित पहिलो कदम हुन सक्छ।

translation.en: Should a pregnant patient book a check-up for throbbing headache that occurs after climbing stairs again this month?
translation.ne: गर्भवती बिरामीले सिँढी चढेपछि यो महिना फेरि हुने धड्केजस्तो टाउको दुखाइका लागि जाँचको समय लिनुपर्छ?

translation.en: A teenager reports mild fever after dental cleaning for the first time, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: किशोरकिशोरीले दाँत सफा गराएपछि पहिलो पटक हल्का ज्वरो भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before the appointment, a young child can write whether sudden panic is constant, comes in episodes, or follows after returning from travel.

translation.en: Before using prenatal vitamins for sudden panic, a young child should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: अचानक आत्तिनेका लागि गर्भावस्थाका भिटामिन प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सानो बच्चाले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: A person with high blood pressure reports ear discharge after skipping breakfast for several weeks, so the visit should include when it began and what makes it better.
translation.ne: उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले बिहानको खाना नखाएपछि धेरै हप्तादेखि कानबाट तरल बग्ने भएको बताउँछ, त्यसैले भेटमा कहिले सुरु भयो र के गर्दा कम हुन्छ भन्ने समावेश हुनुपर्छ।

translation.en: Before using antibiotic syrup for ear discharge, a person with high blood pressure should confirm the dose, timing, and possible allergy history.
translation.ne: कानबाट तरल बग्नेका लागि एन्टिबायोटिक सिरप प्रयोग गर्नुअघि उच्च रक्तचाप भएको व्यक्तिले मात्रा, समय र सम्भावित एलर्जी इतिहास पुष्टि गर्नुपर्छ।

translation.en: When sorting clinic cases, fast heartbeat plus major breathing trouble should be placed ahead of routine post-delivery care.
